newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Chiluba sets Zambian polls for November 18.
newsitem.headline: Chiluba sets Zambian polls for November 18.

text.p: Zambian President Frederick Chiluba on Saturday set November 18 as the date for presidential and parliamentary elections which were due to have been held by the end of October.

"I am happy to announce the presidential and parliamentary elections will be held on November 18," Chiluba told a rally of his Movement for Multi-party Democracy (MMD) party in the central town of Kabwe.
Chiluba said he had dissolved parliament effective from October 18.

Parliament's five-year term was due to expire on October 31 and critics of Chiluba have been saying that his failure to set a date for new elections this month would leave a constitutional power vacuum.
